alt: Posterior view of the right forearm showing the superficial extensor compartment: triceps brachii, brachioradialis, extensor carpi radialis longus and brevis, extensor digitorum, extensor digiti minimi, extensor carpi ulnaris, anconeus, and the outcropping thumb muscles (abductor pollicis longus, extensor pollicis brevis and longus), with the lateral epicondyle of the humerus marked as their common origin.
caption: Superficial posterior (extensor) compartment of the forearm (OpenStax): extensor carpi radialis longus and brevis, extensor digitorum, extensor digiti minimi, extensor carpi ulnaris, anconeus and the outcropping thumb muscles - all radial nerve, mostly from the lateral epicondyle.
